messages:
maria_cs: Heads up: customer 'HorizonApps' reports assistant returning data from the wrong tool when using parallel tool calls (search + billing_lookup). They observed invoice data from another tenant show up in the response and a big billing spike. Ticket INC-4721. Assigning to @kevin_sre and @nina_ml :warning:

kevin_sre: Can you paste the original request payload and the client_request_id they saw? Also which model + SDK version and whether they used parallel vs sequential invocation?

maria_cs: Payload (redacted) below — they used the SDK fanout mode and flagged "parallel": true. client_request_id: hzn-2026-03-15-9934

```
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-1",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Find email for John Doe and fetch latest invoice"}],
  "tool_calls": [
    {"name":"company_search","mode":"parallel","tag":"tr-1"},
    {"name":"billing_lookup","mode":"parallel","tag":"tr-1"}
  ],
  "client_request_id": "hzn-2026-03-15-9934"
}
```

maria_cs: Customer says tool_results came back OK individually but the assistant final message mixed fields (invoice from another account). They also reported ~800 extra billing hits during the incident window.

nina_ml: That payload is suspicious — both parallel calls used the same tag "tr-1". If tags are not unique per invocation the router/coalescer can mis-associate results. @samir_eng can you check the orchestration logs for collision or reuse of tags?

samir_eng: Requesting sample tool_results from the customer. Also need SDK call path (which helper they used to build tags).

maria_cs: They sent the tool_results snippet and final assistant output (redacted):

```
"tool_results": [
  {"tag": "tr-1", "result": {"customer_id": "C123"}, "tool": "company_search"},
  {"tag": "tr-2", "result": {"invoice_id": "INV-999", "amount": 120.00}, "tool": "billing_lookup"}
]
"final_response": "customer_id=C123, invoice_id=INV-123, amount=120.00"
```

maria_cs: Note invoice_id in final_response (INV-123) does not match tool_results (INV-999).

kevin_sre: That confirms mixing. Which SDK version? There was a change in tag generation behavior between js-client@2.3.1 and 2.4.0 (short tags -> uuid).

maria_cs: Customer is on js-client@2.3.1 in prod. They briefly upgraded a staging job to 2.4.0 and couldn't reproduce. Only hitting prod under high concurrency.

nina_ml: Hypothesis: non-unique tags + concurrency -> router's coalescing uses tag -> slot mapping that can collide across in-flight tool invocations. Short tags collide under load. Quick mitigation: require per-invocation UUID tags and reject duplicate tags server-side. I'll open a PR to change the orchestration to assert uniqueness and fall back to sequential combine if duplicates detected. Also add a regression that runs 1k parallel combos and asserts mapping is stable.

samir_eng: I repro'd locally with a stress harness. Attaching sanitized log snippet showing collision events:

```
[2026-03-15T14:22:01Z] req hzn-2026-03-15-9934 tool tr-1 company_search start
[2026-03-15T14:22:01Z] req hzn-2026-03-15-9934 tool tr-1 billing_lookup start
[2026-03-15T14:22:02Z] req hzn-2026-03-15-9934 tool tr-2 billing_lookup finish
[2026-03-15T14:22:02Z] req hzn-2026-03-15-9934 tool tr-1 company_search finish
[2026-03-15T14:22:02Z] router matched result tr-1 -> slot 0
[2026-03-15T14:22:02Z] router matched result tr-2 -> slot 1
[2026-03-15T14:22:02Z] coalesce assigned tr-1 to billing_lookup (collision)
```

kevin_sre: OK — coalescer logic is brittle when tags are reused. Short-term mitigation: 1) ask customer to upgrade to js-client@2.4.0 which uses UUID tags OR set their calls to sequential for billing_lookup; 2) we should push a server-side guard that rejects duplicate tags per request and returns 400 + error message (fail-fast).

nina_ml: I'll prepare a hotfix PR that enforces tag uniqueness and falls back to deterministic ordering when duplicates detected. Plan: PR today -> unit/regression tests tonight -> canary deploy tomorrow morning.

maria_cs: Customer wants immediate mitigations they can apply now. Suggested message to them: rotate API key to limit exposure window, upgrade SDK to 2.4.0, or temporarily mark billing_lookup as sequential, and we'll run a canary fix on our side.

billing-bot: Billing alert created: BILL-782. Linked to INC-4721 and request hzn-2026-03-15-9934.

ops-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: 2026-03-16T02:00:00Z UTC — 10% -> 50% -> 100% if checks pass.

kevin_sre: Also recommend we search logs for other requests from this customer within the same time window to quantify exposure and scope. Legal/security may need to be looped depending on PII.

maria_cs: Customer agreed to rotate key and set sequential flag. They want ETA for server-side patch. Nina, what's ETA?

nina_ml: PR opened (link redacted). Tests are green locally. Target canary tomorrow morning. ETA ~24 hours.

maria_cs: Thanks everyone — I'll update INC-4721 and notify HorizonApps of the mitigation steps and ETA.

kevin_sre: After patch, we should run a tenant-wide audit and send a short postmortem to the customer with scope, root cause (tag collision under parallel fanout), mitigation, and timeline.

maria_cs: Agreed. I'll draft the customer-facing postmortem after the canary is green. :white_check_mark:
